title: Institute essay: an AI research institute's long-form explainer grammar - ivory page, one clay accent, a book serif against a neutral sans, figures on graph paper with watercolour bars and a sticky note
summary: Ivory ground and near-black ink; a transitional book serif for display and body and a neutral grotesque for every label, caption and legend; a 640 px reading column that figures break out of to full width on 22-unit graph paper; one clay accent (the hero's pixel burst, footnote marks, the quote glyph); five data hues only inside figures, as watercolour-textured bars and tiles; a sticky note card riding on a figure; three parallel scenario cards; pill buttons; a big pull quote.

provenance.case: research-report kit: an original self-contained long-read page (a research report on three scenarios of an AI capex cycle, every figure, number and quote a labelled placeholder) in examples/institute-essay-report-kit, and five parametric parts of it as templates.
provenance.lineage: AI research institute long-form explainer and research-essay pages. Two public reference pages the owner named, captured and measured privately in Chrome (computed styles, 2026-11-21); the captures stay private and are not shipped. Borrowed: the grammar and the measured numbers. Never borrowed: any name, logo, wordmark, picture, copy or the original proprietary typefaces.
provenance.borrow: Borrow grammar, never assets. Every word, figure and number is our own placeholder; the faces are open (Source Serif 4, Inter, Noto Serif SC, Noto Sans SC), named and never bundled; the pixel burst is generated from a seed.
provenance.rounds: One round: measured first, then the five templates and the kit page built on the numbers; template check --browser 0 findings on every default render.
measured: Ground #FAF9F5, ink #141413, secondary text #5E5D59, faint #87867F, neutrals #BDBAAE and #E3E0D4, paper card #F5F4ED; the dark theme's ground is #141413.

Clay #D97757 on the hero's pixel burst, footnote references and the quote glyph. Data hues inside figures only: purple #918BD6, blue #6A9BCC, amber #F0AC54, green #217D5D, red #B0403A; the neutral data tile is #D6D3C6.

Type: display and body a transitional book serif, labels, captions, legends and subheads a neutral grotesque. H1 78 px / 1.1 weight 400 serif; deck 17 px sans #5E5D59; body serif 17 / 26 px; reading column 640 px; H3 sans 17 px bold; footnotes heading sans 13 px weight 500 #5E5D59; pull quote serif 36 / 45 px about 946 px wide with a large open-quote glyph; captions sans 13-17 px #5E5D59.

Devices: a grey drop cap about four lines tall; a bold sans lead-in sentence; 'Finding N: topic' in faint serif about 28 px above a one-sentence claim in ink serif about 28 px; figures full width on graph paper (22 px grid, very light lines) with a bold italic 'How to read this:' caption and a legend of 12 px squares; an asterisk footnote line; a sticky note card (paper #F5F4ED, 1 px hairline, radius 6, 340 px wide, bold sans title and serif text) riding on a figure's left; three parallel scenario cards; timeline rows (small sans date, bold sans title, serif sentence); superscript footnotes into an endnote list; italic credits with version and month; pill buttons (radius 99, 1 px hairline) for the hero's calls to action.

Hero picture: a seeded pixel burst of clay rounded squares with a watercolour and paper texture (SVG turbulence plus displacement), large, to the right of the title. Bars and tiles inside figures carry the same texture.
64 px: with the wordmark masked, an ivory page with a serif title, a clay burst and a graph-paper figure reads as the grammar and apart from every game pack in the bank.

ivory.use: the page ground and the figure ground

mute.use: the deck, captions, legends, footnotes, small labels (6.3:1 on ivory)

faint.use: large type only (the 'Finding N' label, drop cap): 3.5:1 on ivory passes the 3:1 of large type and fails 4.5:1 for small

stone.use: pill hairlines, chart guides and axes

paper.use: the sticky note and scenario cards

clay.use: the one accent: the hero burst, footnote marks, the quote glyph (2.96:1 on ivory, so decoration or marks, not text)

purple.use: data hue, inside figures only (the mild scenario)

blue.use: data hue, inside figures only (the neutral scenario)

amber.use: data hue, inside figures only (the aggressive scenario)

tile.use: the neutral data tile and bar tracks

night.use: the dark theme's ground (templates take theme=dark)

serif.use: display, claims, quotes and body: a transitional book serif, weight 400; Noto Serif SC carries CJK

sans.use: labels, captions, legends, values, pills, subheads (bold for lead-ins and H3); Noto Sans SC carries CJK

fonts.resolve: fonts query --style mincho (Noto Serif SC) and --style gothic (Noto Sans SC) cover CJK copy; Source Serif 4 and Inter are Latin faces, so a CJK string falls through to the stack's second family inside one role, the same family for the whole role.
fonts.licence: All roles use SIL OFL 1.1 fonts. The original pages' own proprietary typefaces are not used and not named.
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. --font-dir <dir> reads coverage and embeds the faces.

grammar: Ivory #FAF9F5 ground, near-black ink; one clay accent; the five data hues only inside figures; no gradient, no shadow beyond a 1 px hairline.
Serif for display and body, sans for every label: titles, claims, quotes and sentences are serif; deck, captions, legends, values, pills and subheads are sans (bold for lead-ins).

A 640 px reading column; figures break out to full width on 22-unit graph paper between two hairlines, with a centred bold figure title, a legend of 12-14 unit squares, an asterisk footnote line and a bold italic 'How to read this:' caption.
Findings: 'Finding N: topic' in faint serif above a one-sentence claim in ink serif; the figure follows.
A sticky note card (paper, 1 px hairline, radius 6, 340-360 wide, bold sans title over serif text) rides on a figure's left and never over the plot.
Three parallel scenario cards with a swatch row (data hue by level, neutral tile for the rest), bold sans title, sans subtitle and one serif sentence; timeline rows of date, title and sentence.
Hero: serif title (two lines) left, sans deck, two pill buttons, a meta line; a large seeded pixel burst of clay rounded squares right, with a watercolour and paper texture.
Pull quote: serif at about 2x body, a large clay open-quote glyph, a sans attribution; credits in italic with version and month.

procedural: graph paper: a 22-unit pattern of 1-unit lines in #EBE8DC over the ivory ground
a watercolour filter (feTurbulence displacement plus a soft-light grain) on bars, tiles, swatches and the burst
the pixel burst: a 15 x 15 grid of rounded clay squares kept by a ray-and-noise score, seeded (cover.essay-hero --param seed --param density)
fan charts: seeded dashed polylines in the data hues
recipes: A paper grain for a whole page: materials generate --generator paper --seed 1, laid at 25-40% over the ivory ground (the templates use the in-SVG filter instead).
collage: No pictures: figures are drawn. Text never sits on a textured shape; values and labels sit beside bars on the paper.
materials.sources: Everything is drawn or generated from a seed.

grammar: Bars grow from the baseline to their width in 0.9 s with an ease-out when the figure scrolls to 30% in view; nothing else animates.
Hover on pills and table-of-contents links tints the ground to paper; links keep a 1 px underline offset 3.

guidance: 64 px distinctiveness (guidance): shrink the render to 64 px tall with the wordmark masked; the ivory ground, the serif title, the clay burst or the graph-paper figure should still read. A dark-led or grey-led page reads as another pack.

The faint grey #87867F is for large type only (3.5:1 on ivory); every small line (deck, caption, legend, footnote, meta) uses the secondary #5E5D59. Clay is 2.96:1 on ivory: decoration and marks, never running text.
Latin serif and sans faces have no CJK: keep each string in one role and let the stack's second family carry the CJK; do not mix a CJK clause into a bold italic lead-in.
Figures: no text on a watercolour shape; a value is derived from its parameter (card.essay-finding value_1..3), so a number and its bar cannot disagree.
A lead-in and its sentence are two units: leave at least 8 units between them (the template measures the lead-in's width).
checks.note: The browser check runs on every render. Filters and patterns are not measured by the static check, so the shapes under them are plain rects.

examples.note: The kit page is the example: one self-contained long-read with every device above.

renders.screen: research report long-read (light and dark by system theme, 1440 and 390 wide)
renders.why: a scrolling page with a table of contents, drop cap, bar growth on scroll, a fan chart and footnotes; its parts are the five templates
